scope: Initialization candidate catalog; not an integration manifest or SOTA ranking.

status_definitions.source_verified: Official source identity and stated scope were checked. This does not verify implementation behavior or reported performance.
status_definitions.not_integrated: No official adapter / backend / scorer has been integrated in CADloop.
status_definitions.not_started: No local reproduction or benchmark measurement has been performed.

revision_policy: reviewed_* fields record source metadata observed during initialization; reproduction_* fields remain null until a concrete reproduction protocol is fixed.

entries.name: CAD-Assistant
inputs: text queries, sketches, drawn commands or 3D scans, depending on task
outputs: FreeCAD code, tool observations and final task answer / artifact
entries.code_license: Attribution-NonCommercial (README wording; exact license to inspect)
metrics_to_verify: original SGP-Bench 2D / 3D evaluation as supplied upstream
limitations: Official README describes a tool-augmented VLLM framework integrated with FreeCAD, sketch_recognizer and solid_recognizer.
The released evaluation targets CAD question answering on SGP-Bench; applying the framework to CADGenBench generation/editing would be an adaptation, not an exact paper reproduction.
Docker, FreeCAD, Python OCC and model API access are required upstream.
The README declares an Attribution-NonCommercial license; inspect the exact LICENSE before redistribution or reuse.
No environment was built, API was called or paper score reproduced.

entries.name: CADGenBench reference iterative baseline
outputs: build123d or CadQuery Python and final output.step
metrics_to_verify: official CADGenBench leaderboard scoring after submission
limitations: This is the official repository reference baseline, not a claim of paper SOTA.
The README describes iterative code generation, execution, rendered feedback and repair until valid. Freeze prompts, model identifier, backend and iteration / token budgets for comparison.
The baseline generates artifacts only; public-input validity checks cannot replace private-ground-truth leaderboard scoring.
Model API calls and official submission have not been attempted.

entries.name: CAD-Recode
outputs: CadQuery Python program and reconstructed 3D solid
metrics_to_verify: upstream reconstruction protocols on DeepCAD, Fusion 360 Gallery and CC3D; protocol reproduction requires further code review
limitations: This is a trained point-cloud-to-code reconstruction model, not an agent harness.
The repository links v1, v1.5 and Cadrille assets; fix an explicit model / checkpoint revision before running.
The README reports a historical December 2024 SOTA claim. This catalog makes no current ranking claim.
Comparing against drawing/text-only agents requires a separate point-cloud track or a justified identical input protocol.
Only the official README and repository HEAD were inspected; no weights, dataset or inference demo were downloaded or executed.
